answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the nebula checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The ivory graph is rebuilt each epoch, and as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the dune audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 5 times its size, so a group of 60 keys loses far more than 60 single identities would. That is 37 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
